understood_as: Preserve all prior runs. Train five new shared multigoal normal sources, then exactly D-on and D-delivery mutant adaptations. Lock engine-validated new complete-state layouts before policy evaluation. Compare final mutant adoption directly, not the historical fixed-subtracted U. No common-state mechanism analysis, other arms, tuning, extension, or seed replacement.
seed_selection: First five unused integer seeds at or above 200, checked against available RAID run directories, run manifests, checkpoint configs and repository manifests before launch. Audit is saved separately; stop on collision.
condition_mapping: null selects all goal IDs 0..11. [11] selects delivery-only TD loss; architecture, forward computation, inherited Adam state, advice goal and all other update rules are identical.
missing_pair_rule: Stop and report failed/missing seeds explicitly; never impute missing outcomes as zero, silently drop them, or replace seeds. A complete five-pair primary requires all final checkpoints.
adoption_equation: Initial duplicate balance=0; each active engine transition adds max(total_grain_after-total_grain_before,0). Actual delivery consumes min(balance,delivered_increment). Episode adoption is total consumed duplicated grain > 0. Stage and subsequent-success rates are separate diagnostics.
teacher_loss: Sum selected-head half-squared TD errors divided by valid transitions; delivery-head derivative is unchanged. Shared weights and inherited Adam momentum can change other heads.
actor_advice: Only commanded delivery goal 11 during adaptation; pretraining retains workshop12. Existing BC schedule spans global updates 0..4608 without restart.

panel.generation: Add distinct obstacle arrangements to the existing 5x5 workshop footprint, preserving role coordinates and observation/action/reward contracts. Select first eight canonical-geometry-unique layouts with exact-kernel normal witnesses from both starts and a legal fixed-prefix rebuild opportunity. No policy query or outcome selection.
panel.novelty_limit: New wall arrangements within the same small workshop, not arbitrary-map or unseen-task generalization. Shared role geometry and route overlap are reported, not equated with independence.
panel.hashes: Complete environment fields with dtype/shape and translation/D4-canonical walkable and role geometry; compare TRAIN/VALIDATION/TEST and within panel.

evaluation.primary: Final D-on minus D-delivery violation_delivery_rate on eight natural mutant starts, mode, within learner seed. This is NOT U.
evaluation.adoption: Existing conservation-increase balance consumed by actual delivery, not action invocation alone.
evaluation.source: The same seed's frozen update-512 source, commanded delivery goal.
evaluation.policy_queries: Only after all training jobs terminate; no intermediate holdout evaluation.
evaluation.return: success * 0.995^(controlled_length-1); absolute world tick still terminates at 128, no fresh horizon for opportunity starts.

failure_contract: Stop on nonfinite learning state/metrics, integrity or contract violation. Record terminal failure without replacing seed. Capacity failures pause safely; interrupted jobs resume their last verified checkpoint. Worker terminal failure returns cleanly to host resource management but never marks science complete.
historical_contract: Existing D-delivery result and final states are audited; historical +20pp is Delta U, distinct from this primary difference. D-on's target count is 12, D-delivery's is 1; total signal and compute are not matched.

validation_audit.ground_truth: Physical engine states, conserved grain and exact legal normal/exploit action witnesses; never teacher recommendations or policy confidence as correctness labels.
validation_audit.holdout_boundary: No learned checkpoint is queried by generator or panel validation. Full generator, RNG, candidate order and complete states are published. A common small-map design remains a limitation, not evidence of arbitrary map generalization.
validation_audit.consistency: This manifest is the new experiment contract. Historical manifests and results remain unchanged. New code references the existing collector/updater and checks recipe equality, rather than redefining their algorithms.
